newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude looks to test $19.82 support.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - NYMEX crude looks to test $19.82 support.

text.p: NEARBY MONTH CLOSE * SUPPORT * RESIST * RSI-14 * MA-10 * MA-20
+NYMEX crude oil futures are expected to test support on Tuesday and dealers said the first level to watch lies at around $19.82.
+A failure to break through support will be positive and may lead to a test of key resistance at around $20.25.
NYMEX crude oil futures are expected to soften on Tuesday and test support at $19.82 and possibly $19.73, traders and technical analysts said.
June crude oil ended the day eight cents down at $19.91 a barrel on Monday.

May gasoline and heating oil, both of which expire on Wednesday, respectively closed at 62.34 cents a gallon and 56.53 cents, a fall of 0.16 cents in the case of gasoline and a gain of 0.63 cents for heating oil.
"I expect some erosion of prices today," one New York-based dealer said, and he pegged support at $19.73 and then resistance at $20.03 and then $20.25.

Dealers also noted that the market had touched, and failed to break lower than, $19.82 in the past two sessions. This corresponds, too, to the 10-day moving average on the continuous chart. This would form the first line of defence against any down move, chartists added.
GNI research in London said in a daily report that $19.83 was an important level because it represents the current level of a key falling trendline on the continuous chart.
"This is an important level and there should be a break away from this line (technicals suggest it could be in either direction) during the next few days."
Refco Inc. saw a similar support level.
"Look for support to be seen at the $19.82 level followed by $19.62," their daily report said, adding that resistance would be encountered at $20.22 to $20.25.
Heating oil, Refco said, would possibly test resistance 57.25 cents in the near term, while gasoline would find support at 61.90 and resistance at 63.10.
